title.narrative: Strengthening of Indigenous Peoples and Territories in the Northeast, Minas Gerais and Espírito Santo

description.narrative: Strengthen dialogue and articulation among the indigenous peoples of the Northeast, Minas Gerais and Espírito Santo, promoting improved protection and management of indigenous territories. Qualify management at APOINME headquarters and optimize capacities of APOINME's regional offices, intensifying actions in the field, including actions promoted by and for indigenous women.Institutional strengthening of selected APOINME grassroots associations.
